WP-40c (DEC-82): a NECESSARY condition on every tamifying topology (not shown violated anywhere): any tamifying topology T on M̃ satisfies, at every point s fixed by a deck transformation f and for every natural neighbourhood W of s and neighbourhood E of D(s), that some regular z is joined to f z inside W ∩ reg ∩ D⁻¹(E) (GX.IsTamifyingTopology.exists_joinedIn_devSmall: (C) makes N ∩ f⁻¹N a neighbourhood, (D) and local path-connectedness make its regular part path-connected). WP-40c: at a point of finite local degree (a natural neighbourhood met by its deck translates only through finitely many transformations fixing the point), every tamifying topology is natural, given M̃ → M Galoisian (GX.IsTamifyingTopology.nhds_eq_of_finite_stab, GX.IsTamifyingTopology.nhds_eq_of_free) — the claim 'at finite local degree (A)+(C) force T_α natural' of WP-35f, now proved. kb_proposals: A topology passed as an argument of type TopologicalSpace α is a LOCAL INSTANCE for every later binder and every `have`: `δ : α ≃ₜ α`, `deckGroup`, `connectedComponentIn` silently use it. Wrap it (`structure GX.WrappedTop α where top : TopologicalSpace α`) and write `@nhds _ T.top`; prove explicit-topology versions of mathlib lemmas by `letI := t; exact …` (GX.mem_nhds_iff_of and siblings in SingularII/Models).

Dot notation on a structure field of an explicit-topology Prop (`hT.isPortly.dense x`, `h.mono`, `hc.comp`) re-synthesizes the instance and fails with 'synthesized … not definitionally equal'; use `@IsPortly.dense _ T _ h` or a `letI` wrapper lemma.

To glue a topology defined by neighbourhood filters, `TopologicalSpace.mkOfNhds` + `nhds_mkOfNhds` (pure ≤ n, and s ∈ n a → ∀ᶠ y in n a, s ∈ n y) is far cheaper than a generateFrom: GX.chartTop/GX.nhds_chartTop.

Uniqueness of lifts into a maximal covering: maps continuous on an open set, with the same projection and regular over a dense preconnected open part, agreeing at one regular point, agree (GX.eqOn_maxBranched_of_base_eq); with regular transitivity they differ by a deck transformation (GX.exists_deck_eqOn_of_base_eq).
Identifiers with Latin-1 letters (Û, V̂, Ẑ) are rejected by the parser ('expected token'); Greek and letterlike symbols are fine.

A quotient topology through non-injective maps is cheap with mkOfNhds: put n y := map Ψ_y (𝓝 f_y) for a chosen preimage; the two mkOfNhds conditions need only that n (Ψ v) = map Ψ (𝓝 v) for every v, which is the Galois property of Ψ (GX.descNhds_eq, GX.nhds_descTop) — no openness of Ψ is needed up front, it follows.

Galoisianity of a sub-covering V̂ → Û between maximal coverings, without building it as a branched covering: move a regular point near v₁ to one near v₂ by a deck transformation (regular transitivity + a path-lifting surjectivity onto the regular part), then pin the singular point with the discreteness of the q-fibre (GX.IsChartDescent.exists_deck).
Beware python str.replace on Lean files: an anchor like '\nend DescTop' also matches '\nend DescTopHelpers'; assert the count is 1.
